Side-by-side evaluation of real model outputs

PROJECT 02 / DATA ANNOTATION

Multilingual text annotation & QA rules

A compact dataset of fictional customer messages labeled for primary intent and urgency. The annotation guide defines six classes, precedence rules, and ambiguous cases, especially the boundary between billing issues and explicit refund requests.

LANGUAGE COVERAGE

Brazilian Portuguese and English, in one workflow.

The interface and evaluation rationale are in English for international reviewers. The annotation dataset includes 30 Brazilian Portuguese and 18 English messages, with documented labeling rules.

02 / WORKING METHOD

Make the decision traceable.

A useful label or preference needs a reason someone else can check. These samples pair judgments with original source IDs, rules, references, and the decisive issue.

  1. 01

    Identify the source

    Record question IDs, answer IDs, model identifiers, and task context.

  2. 02

    Apply a consistent rule

    Score first-turn outputs separately or select one primary intent using precedence rules.

  3. 03

    State the limit

    Explain errors and why a selected eight-case study cannot establish overall model performance.

03 / ABOUT

About me.
